difficulty.child_rule: Use default_difficulty of the exactly-one primary ProblemType in the reviewed child taxonomy.
difficulty.group_rule: Arithmetic mean of the four child candidate difficulties, rounded to 3 decimals.
forbidden: difficulty inferred from source answer correctness
silent fallback when primary ProblemType/default_difficulty is missing

exam_weight.child_semantics: Child Question rows are structural members of a TRUE_FALSE_FOUR group and must not be scored or prioritized as standalone exam items.
exam_weight.group_semantics: Normalized full-group weight aligned with score_question_group(..., max_points=1.0); actual exam blueprint points may override max_points later.

cognitive_level.rule: Remain null until a separate reviewed cognitive-level policy exists.

explanation.rule: Do not synthesize explanations during import.
